strain: C57BL/6J background (SAPAP3 KO and WT littermates)

age.evidence: 5-7-month-old male and female SAPAP3 knockout (KO) mice and their wild-type (WT) littermates, all maintained on a C57BL/6J background

sex.evidence: 5-7-month-old male and female SAPAP3 knockout (KO) mice and their wild-type (WT) littermates

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (Usona Institute Inc.) was dissolved in 0.9% saline and adjusted to pH 7... All solutions were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 10 mL/kg body weight... Animals were treated with 1 mg/kg of psilocybin. Mice received a single dose of psilocybin or vehicle

handling.evidence: Mice were acclimated to handling before drug administration and behavioral testing.

group_housing.evidence: separated into non-sibling groups of the same sex and genotype (n = 2-6 per box).

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12 h light-dark cycle (lights on from 07:00-19:00)... All behavioral testing was conducted during the light phase (09:00-17:00 h).

enrichment_housing.evidence: Mice were housed in standard open-top boxes (34 × 16 × 16 cm); no mention of enrichment items.

assays.assay_name: Three-chamber social interaction test (sociability and social recognition/novelty)
assays.assay_description: Standard three-chamber apparatus (San Diego Instruments), 7 days after a single i.p. dose of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) or vehicle in male and female SAPAP3 KO and WT mice. 5-min habituation to empty apparatus (distance travelled and empty-cage sniffing reported), 10-min sociability trial (Stranger 1 in wire cage vs empty wire cage), 10-min social recognition/novelty trial (Stranger 2 vs familiar Stranger 1). Measures: nose-point sniffing duration (TopScan), chamber time, social indices, bout number and mean bout duration, latency to first sniff, habituation locomotion.

application_type.evidence: All solutions were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a volume of 10 mL/kg body weight.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were first habituated to the empty apparatus for 5 min.

setup_restrain.evidence: psilocybin-treated male SAPAP3 KO mice traveled less than vehicle-treated KO mice while freely exploring the empty social testing apparatus

food_restriction.evidence: Standard three-chamber apparatus; no food present in the apparatus during testing (ad libitum chow only in home cage).

water_restriction.evidence: Standard three-chamber apparatus; no water present in the apparatus during testing (ad libitum water only in home cage).

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice received a single dose of psilocybin or vehicle and underwent behavioral assessment in the three-chamber social interaction test 7 days later

sample_size.evidence: (n = 91; Fig. 1)... n = 11-14 per group for females and n = 8-13 per group for males.

outcomes.summary: Sociability was intact across all groups. Vehicle-treated male SAPAP3 KO mice showed reduced investigation of the novel mouse, and a single 1 mg/kg psilocybin dose given 7 days earlier increased Stranger 2 sniffing and chamber time in male KOs, restoring WT-like levels. Psilocybin did not alter social behaviour in females except reducing latency to first sniff the novel mouse.
outcomes.statistics: Male social novelty sniffing: treatment × cage × genotype F(1,37)=4.24, p=0.047, η²=0.045; vehicle KO vs vehicle WT p=0.007; psilocybin KO vs vehicle KO p=0.032; psilocybin KO vs vehicle WT p=0.570. Male novelty chamber time: cage × genotype × treatment F(1,37)=4.25, p=0.046, η²=0.068; psilocybin KO vs vehicle KO p=0.026. Male sociability treatment F(1,37)=2.45, p=0.126. Female novelty treatment F(1,46)=0.155, p=0.696.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin significantly increased interaction time with the novel mouse in SAPAP3 KO males compared with vehicle treatment (p = 0.032).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Sniffing toward Stranger 1/empty cage/Stranger 2, chamber time, sociability and novelty indices, latency to first sniff, total distance traveled, empty-cage sniffing during habituation, number of bouts and mean bout duration.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: sniffing duration (%) = time with nose point in the relevant interaction zone / total trial duration × 100; no within-session time-course reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: To further characterize this male KO-specific rescue, we examined the total number of bouts and mean bout duration (Supplementary Figure 3)... Follow-up analyses of male social-investigation microstructure

B4_ethological.evidence: Direct stimulus-directed sniffing was treated in the present study as the primary and more socially specific behavioral outcome.

B5_social.evidence: an age- and sex-matched C57BL/6 intruder mouse, designated Stranger 1, was enclosed in a wire cage in one side chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: the social recognition/novelty phase tests whether mice preferentially investigate an unfamiliar conspecific over a familiar one

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Sniffing behavior was quantified using automated nose-point tracking in TopScan 2.00 (CleverSys Inc., USA).

B8_multivariate.evidence: Behavioral data were analyzed using repeated-measures three-way ANOVAs; no multivariate behavioural analysis.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter or refuge described in the three-chamber apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Only wire stimulus cages described in the apparatus; no enrichment objects.

E6_spatial.evidence: standard three-chamber apparatus... enclosed in a wire cage in one side chamber... opposite side chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: Stranger 1, was enclosed in a wire cage in one side chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the testing apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: Mice were first habituated to the empty apparatus for 5 min. Sociability was then assessed during a 10-min trial... In the subsequent 10-min social recognition/novelty trial (all phases in one test session on one day)

D2_session_duration.evidence: Sociability was then assessed during a 10-min trial... subsequent 10min social recognition/novelty trial

D3_recording_days.evidence: underwent behavioral assessment in the three-chamber social interaction test 7 days later

D4_baseline.evidence: The 'baseline/habituation session' occurred 7 days after drug administration; no pre-drug behavioural recording.

D5_followup.evidence: Mice received a single dose of psilocybin or vehicle and underwent behavioral assessment in the three-chamber social interaction test 7 days later

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single behavioural assay (three-chamber SIT); c-Fos immunohistochemistry excluded as non-behavioural.

B3 overridden to Yes (1) against 2/3 candidates: the paper explicitly analyses bout number and mean bout duration as 'social-investigation microstructure', which the rubric lists under bout structure/microstructure.
D1 kept as Single session (modal): habituation, sociability and novelty phases form one same-day test session; gemma's 'Multiple' rejected.
D4 scored 0: the habituation 'baseline' was recorded 7 days post-drug, not before drug administration; qwen's Yes rejected.
D5 scored 1 (modal): testing occurred 7 days after the single dose.
B1 value set to '7+' (score 3) per enumerated measures; gemma's '4-6' label inconsistent with its score.
setup_habituation kept 'yes' (unanimous) but confidence medium because locomotion/empty-cage sniffing data from the habituation phase were reported.
